description: Two privileges for the step-away wheel, both scoped to its own windows by label. `close` is the unlock path (`unlock_with_intention`) reaching back into the app — without it the window would be a block with no way out, which @keel/domain refuses. `emit` is how the wheel reports where your throw landed: the outcome is decided by the hand, not pre-chosen, so it has to travel inward for the log to be true.
